title: Blockchain & Digital Trust
meta_description: Blockchain & Digital Trust services from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust delivers distributed-ledger programs where shared truth has economic value: enterprise DLT networks for multi-party workflows, asset tokenization, smart contract engineering and audit, provenance and traceability, decentralized identity with verifiable credentials, and on-chain analytics for compliance. We are deliberately institution-grade — permissioned networks, key-management discipline, and regulator-readable audit trails.

Tokenized collateral, digital bonds, and e-money pilots have crossed from whitepaper to production at tier-one institutions, while supply chain regulation (EU Deforestation Regulation, Digital Product Passports) makes provenance a compliance requirement rather than a marketing story. The technology matured exactly as the regulatory pull arrived.
The services behind Blockchain & Digital Trust, each page carrying the full build pattern:

items: Permissioned networks for multi-party truth — governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
Instruments as tokens — issuance, custody and lifecycle under securities-law discipline.
Contracts as production software — specification, formal verification and audit before value moves.
Proof, not paperwork — EUDR, DPP and chain-of-custody systems regulators and customers can verify.
Credentials users carry — portable, privacy-preserving verification for workforce and customers.
On-chain transparency, operationalized — analytics, Travel Rule and MiCA-aligned controls.

blocks.title: The flow your team would run — Blockchain & Digital Trust
blocks.note: Named stages, not generic boxes — this is the Blockchain & Digital Trust programs path as built.

blocks.x: What a Blockchain & Digital Trust engagement shares across services: the baseline is signed, the slice is bounded, and the gates can stop the program — that last part is a feature. Baselines are signed in the first two weeks, the working slice lands inside the quarter, and the value ledger stays open to your finance team.
Evidence from Blockchain & Digital Trust, published with the client's permission to show numbers but never names:

items: Bordereaux automation and settlement evidence — reconciliation effort down 74%
Sell-through +8 points and hero-SKU availability +24% — assortment intelligence
EUDR due-diligence automated — compliance evidence in hours, premium channels opened

blocks.x: The tower runs on Dataq Ledger, Dataq Sentinel — platforms with documented controls, so the governance story is part of the product rather than an annex.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: Blockchain & Digital Trust, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
